SuperAwesomeMagicalMusic

Releases of SuperAwesomeMagicalMusic, a music player for self-hosters (Jellyfin first, with YouTube Music, Qobuz, SiriusXM, radio and Android Auto), built and signed by the project's GitHub Actions.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://603madison.github.io/SuperAwesomeMagicalMusic-Standalone/repo
